subject: Subnet bridge compatibility & compliance review for private deployment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Ramos <olivia.ramos@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Subnet bridge compatibility & compliance review for private deployment

Olivia,

Thanks for the diagram you shared last week. Before we lock the private deployment handoff, I want one short technical pass specifically on the subnet bridge between your co-lo edge and the customer VPC. We need to confirm three items so our IaC and CI changes can be finalized: 

- IP plan collision checks: confirm the full prefix ranges for the bridge and any reserved subnets.
- MTU and VXLAN settings: we need explicit MTU and encapsulation behavior to set the Terraform networking modules and the Helm chart tolerations correctly.
- Evidence for network segmentation controls: Acme's compliance team asked for a short proof pack showing ACLs and route-table snapshots we can reference in the audit.

Attached is a trimmed checklist I use for these handoffs. Can you either: (A) mark the doc with the values and return it, or (B) propose a 30-minute tech alignment call this week and we can fill it out together?

Attachment: subnet-design-v2.pdf (diagram + checklist)

Primary ask: if you can provide the CIDR allocations and confirm whether the bridge uses an L3 or L2 overlay by EOD Wednesday (PST), we can run the Terraform plan against the private environment and validate there are no drift or overlap errors.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Sr. PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Ramos <olivia.ramos@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme NetOps <netops@acme.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subnet bridge compatibility & compliance review for private deployment

On Sun, Aug 30, 2026 at 09:17 AM PDT Marissa Cole wrote:
> Olivia,
>
> Thanks for the diagram you shared last week. Before we lock the private deployment handoff, I want one short technical pass specifically on the subnet bridge between your co-lo edge and the customer VPC. We need to confirm three items so our IaC and CI changes can be finalized: ...

Thanks Marissa,

Appreciate the concise checklist. Quick answers inline below and I attached our network diagram plus the compliance snapshot we pulled for the same bridge.

- CIDR allocations: Bridge uses 10.250.0.0/22 on the co-lo edge heading to the customer VPC. Reserved subnets: 10.250.3.0/24 for management, 10.250.2.0/24 for monitoring.
- Overlay: We are running an L3 VXLAN overlay for the bridge; inner MTU is 1500, overlay MTU negotiated to 1450. We will publish the exact tunnel options in the next revision.
- Segmentation evidence: attached is a short export of route tables and ACLs we can sign off for audit purposes. Note that Acme's compliance asked us to retain the last 90 days of route snapshots; we can export those on request.

Attachments: acme-net-diagram-aug2026.pdf, acme-compliance-evidence.xlsx

We can do a 30-minute sync Tuesday 10:00-10:30 PDT if that works for your team — would be Karthik and one of our network engineers on the call.

- Olivia Ramos
Lead Network Engineer
Acme Corp

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Olivia Ramos <olivia.ramos@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subnet bridge compatibility & compliance review for private deployment

Thanks Olivia — that answers most of it. Two follow-ups from the infra side before we confirm our CI gates: 

1) Terraform module expectations
- We'll need the explicit MTU and overlay mode as module inputs so we can pin the azure/arn/etc provider behaviours. I'll add mtux_overlay and overlay_mode variables to privnet-module and start a feature branch: privnet/feature/bridge-1450.

2) CI test additions
- Can we add a quick plan-and-validate job that runs terraform plan against a mocked state to detect IP overlap? Proposed name: premerge/privnet-plan-guard. This job should run on every PR touching the privnet module and fail on any overlap with the provided prefixes file.

3) Compliance artifact handling
- Grace, can you confirm the upload destination and retention for the route-table exports Olivia attached? We prefer keeping the signed CSVs in the secure evidence bucket and linking the URL in the release ticket.

Action items: 
- Marissa: confirm call with Olivia (we're aiming Tue 10:00).
- Grace: confirm evidence bucket + retention.
- Olivia: share the tunnel config snippet if possible (just the MTU and VXLAN flags).

Karthik
Engineering Manager, Private Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Ramos <olivia.ramos@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 15:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subnet bridge compatibility & compliance review for private deployment

All — thanks, this is great progress. Quick summary and next steps: 

- Confirmed values: bridge CIDR 10.250.0.0/22, mgmt 10.250.3.0/24, monitoring 10.250.2.0/24, overlay L3 VXLAN, overlay MTU 1450.
- Karthik will open the privnet feature branch and the premerge plan guard job tomorrow.
- Grace, please upload the acme-compliance-evidence.xlsx to the secure evidence bucket with retention 365 days and post the signed URL to NET-542.

Scheduling: Olivia — Tuesday 10:00 PDT is fine for us. I'll send a calendar invite to lock it and include a short agenda: 1) confirm MTU/tunnel flags, 2) verify Terraform inputs and expected outputs, 3) agree on evidence handoff and CI artifact link.

Links: NET-542 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-542), design doc (https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PRIV/Subnet+Bridge+Design)

Attachments: subnet-design-v2.pdf (updated checklist)

Thanks everyone — see you on the call.

Marissa
Sr. PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
